spans.s:
अशुचि अ-शुचि, इस्, इस्, इ (rt. 2. शुच्), foul,
impure; (इस्), f. impurity, disgrace, degradation.
—अशुचि-ता, f. or अशुचि-त्व, अम्, n. impurity.

अशुद्ध अ-शुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. शुध्), im-
pure; inaccurate; unknown, unascertained.
—अशुद्-
ध-वासक, अस्, m. a vagrant, a suspicious cha-
racter.
अ-शुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, impure; (इस्), f. impurity.

अशुभ अ-शुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, unlucky, in-
auspicious; (अम्), n. sin, a shameful deed, misfortune.

—अशुभोदय (˚भ-उद्˚), अस्, m. inauspicious
omen.

अशुश्रूषा अ-शुश्रूषा, f. inattention, neglect
of service or respect.

अशुष अशुष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. अश्), Ved.
eating, consuming, voracious; (Sāy.) not causing to
dry up, not extinguished (as if fr. rt. शुष्).

अशुष्क अ-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. शुष्), not
dry, moist, fresh, green.

अशूद्र अ-शूद्र, अस्, m. one who is not a
Śūdra.
अशून्य अ-शून्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not empty.

—अशून्य-शयन, अम्, n., अशून्यशयन-द्वितीया,
f., अशून्यशयन-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of certain cere-
monies.
अशूला अ-शूला, f. the tree Vitex Alata.

असु असु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. अस्, to be), breath,
life, spiritual life; life of the spiritual world or departed
spirits; water ?; [cf. ἀάζω, ἄσθμα]; (असवस्),
nom. pl. the five vital breaths or airs of the body;
animal life; (उ), n. reflection, thought or the heart as
the seat of it; grief.
—असु-धारण, अम्, n. life,
existence.
—असु-नीत, अम्, n., Ved. the world of
spirits, or (अस्), m. the lord of the spirits.
—असु-नीति,
इस्, f., Ved. the life or the world of spirits; that life
personified as a female deity invoked for the preserva-
tion of life, or as Yama, lord of the dead.
—असु-
भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking of life; fear about life;
danger of life.
—असु-भृत्, त्, m. breathing, living, a
creature.
—असु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, living, breathing;
(मान्), m. life, the principle of vitality, the portion of
spirit connected with the attributes of existence.
—असु-
सम, अस्, आ, अम्, dearly loved, as dear as life; (अस्),
m. a husband, a lover.

असू अ-सू, ऊस्, ऊस्, m. f. (rt. 1. सु, to bring
forth), Ved. not bringing forth, barren.

आशु आशु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. 1. अश्),
fast, quick, going quickly; (उ), ind. quickly, quick,
immediately, directly; (उस्), m., Ved. the quick one,
a horse; (उस् or उ), m. n. rice ripening quickly in the
rainy season; [cf. Gr. ὠκύς, ὤκιστος Lat. acu in
acupedeus, ôcissimus: of the same origin may be
the Lat. aquila and accipiter.]
—आशु-कारिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, doing anything quickly, smart, active; (in medic.)
operating speedily.
—आशु-कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, easily pro-
voked, irritable.
—आशु-क्रिया, f. quick procedure.
—आशु-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going or moving quickly,
swift, fleet; (अस्), m. the wind; the sun; an arrow;
N. of one of the first five followers of Śākya-muni.
—आशु-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going or moving quickly;
(ई), m. an epithet of the sun.
—आशुङ्-ग, अस्, m., Ved.
N. of an animal, perhaps a bird; going to the horse (?).
—आशु-तोष, अस्, आ, अम्, easily pleased or appeased;
(अस्), m., N. of Śiva.
—आशु-त्व, अम्, n. quickness.
—आशु-पत्त्री, f. a tree which yields frankincense,
Boswellia Serrata.
—आशु-पत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. flying
quickly.
—आशु-फल, अस्, m. a kind of weapon.
—आशु-बोध, ‘easily understood,’ ‘teaching quickly,’
title of a grammar.
—आशु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. quick;
(अत्), ind. quickly.
—१. आशु-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.)
going quickly.
—आशु-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pos-
sessing a fast chariot.
—आशु-व्रीहि, इस्, m. rice ripen-
ing quickly in the rainy season.
—आशु-षेण, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. having swift arrows.
—आशु-हेमन्, आ, m.,
Ved. urged to fast course, running on quickly; inciting
his horses (as an epithet of Agni, especially when
regarded as Apāṃ-napāt).
—आशु-हेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
Ved. having neighing horses; (Sāy.) having quick
horses or quickly praised; epithet of the Aśvins.
—आश्व्-
अपस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. acting quickly.
—आश्व्-अश्व, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. possessed of quick horses; an epithet of
the Maruts.
—आश्वश्व्य, अम्, n., Ved. possession of
quick horses.

आसु 1. आ-सु, cl. 5. P., Ved. -सुनोति, -सोतुम्,
to press out Soma juice, to distil.

आसु 2. आ-सु, cl. 2. P., Ved. -सौति, -सोतुम्,
to bring forth, excite.

आसू आ-सू, cl. 6. P., Ved. -सुवति, -सवितुम्,
to bring or send quickly, yield, grant.

असुर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. living, alive, spiritual; an
epithet of the supreme spirit; Varuṇa; incorporeal, super-
human, divine; (अस्), m. spirit; an incorporeal being
of an evil kind; an evil spirit, a demon; a ghost or
spectre; a general name for the chief of the Asuras
[these Asuras are often regarded as the children of
Diti by Kaśyapa, see दैत्य; as such they are
demons of the first order in perpetual hostility with
the gods, and must not be confounded with the
Rākṣasas or imps who animate dead bodies and
disturb sacrifices]; the sun; Rāhu; an elephant; N.
of a warrior-tribe; (according to Sāy.) a cloud ?;
(आ), f. night; a zodiacal sign; a prostitute; (ई), f. a
female demon, the wife of an Asura; N. of the plant
Sinapis Racemosa Roxb. [Observe, in later San-
skṛt, सुर has been formed from असुर, as सित
from असित, q. v.]
—असुर-कुमार, आस्, m. pl. a
class of deities belonging to the Bhavanādhīśas.
—असुर-क्षयण, अस्, आ, अम्, or असुर-क्षिति,
इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. destroying the Asuras.
—असुर-त्व,
अम्, n., Ved. spirituality, supernatural or divine dig-
nity.
—असुर-माया, f., Ved. demoniacal magic.
—असुर-रक्षस, आनि, n. pl., Ved. the Asuras
and Rākṣasas; (अम्), n. sing. a demoniacal being,
partaking of the qualities of both the classes of
evil spirits.
—असुर-राज्, ट्, m. king of the Asuras,
[]
epithet of the Asura Baka.
—असुर-रिपु, उस्, m.
enemy of the Asuras, epithet of Viṣṇu.
—असुर-
सूदन, अस्, m. destroyer of the Asuras, epithet of
Viṣṇu.
—असुर-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ, Ved. destroying
the Asuras, epithet of Agni, Indra, &c.
—असुरा-
चार्य (˚र-आच्˚), अस्, m. teacher of the Asuras;
epithet of the regent of the planet Venus.
—असुरा-
धिप (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, m. lord of the Asuras; N. of
Bali Vairocani and of Māyādhara.
—असुराह्व (˚र-
आह्˚), अम्, n. bell-metal, named after an Asura.
असुर असुर. See under असु.

असूर अ-सूर, अम्, n., Ved. absence of a
person to press out the Soma juice; (Sāy.) a place
or country devoid of praise or worship.

आसुर आसुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. असुर), spiritual,
divine; belonging to or devoted to evil spirits; be-
longing or relating to the Asuras; infernal, demoni-
acal; (अस्), m. an Asura or demon; a form of mar-
riage in which the bridegroom purchases the bride
from her father and paternal kinsmen; (आस्), m. pl.
the stars of the southern hemisphere; a prince of the
warrior-tribe Asura; (ई), f. a division of medicine,
surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying
the actual cautery; N. of the plant Sinapis Ramosa;
(अम्), n. blood; black salt.

आसुर; under (ई), f. add — an epithet of बुद्धि
in the Sāṅkhya philosophy.

असुर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. incorporeal, spiritual,
divine; demoniacal, belonging to the Asuras; (अम्),
n. spirituality, divine nature; the incorporeal, the
collective body of spiritual beings; (according to
Sāy.) the water of the clouds.
असूर्य अ-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sunless.

असुकर अ-सुकर, अस्, आ, अम्, not easy to
be done, difficult, arduous.

असुक्षण असुक्षण, a various reading for
असूक्षण, q. v.

असूक्षण असूक्षण or असुक्षण or असुर्-
क्षण or असूर्क्षण or अस्तर्क्षण, अम्, n.
(etymology doubtful), disrespect.

असुख अ-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, unhappy, sorrow-
ful, melancholic; (अम्), n. sorrow, pain, affliction.
—असुख-जीविका, f. a joyless life.
—असुख-पीडित,
अस्, आ, अम्, pained with grief.
—असुखावह (˚ख-
आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, producing unhappiness.
—असुखा-
विष्ट (˚ख-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, afflicted with grief,
pain, or unhappiness.
—असुखोदय (˚ख-उद्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, causing or ending in unhappiness.
—असुखो-
दर्क (˚ख-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, productive of or
ending in unhappiness.
अ-सुखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, unhappy, sorrowful, afflicted.

असुत 1. अ-सुत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 2. सु), Ved. not
pressed out, not cleared or purified, not ready (as
the Soma juice).

असुत 2. अ-सुत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. सु), child-
less. See अ-सू.

अ-सूत or अ-सूतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who
has not brought forth, barren.

अ-सुन्व, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-सुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्,
or अ-सुष्वि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. not pressing out the
Soma juice, not worshipping the gods, wicked.

असुतर अ-सुतर, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. तृ), not to
be easily passed.

असुतृप् अ-सुतृप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. insatiable,
not easily satiated.

असुनिरस अ-सुनिरस, अस्, आ, अम्, disagree-
able, unpleasant, offensive.

असुन्दर अ-सुन्दर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, plain,
ugly; improper, unbecoming.

असुप्त अ-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not asleep.
—अ-
सुप्त-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, never closing the eyes in sleep,
ever-seeing.

असुम्न अ-सुम्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. contrary,
adverse.

असुरक्ष अ-सुरक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, perishable,
volatile, transitory.

अ-सुरक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, difficult of retention or
preservation.

असुरसा अ-सुरसा, f. the plant Basilicum
Pilosum Benth.

असुलभ अ-सुलभ, अस्, आ, अम्, difficult of
attainment.
असुष्वि अ-सुष्वि. See under. 1. अ-सुत.

असुस्थ अ-सुस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, unwell, indis-
posed, not well placed, uncomfortable.
—असुस्थ-ता,
f. indisposition, sickness.

असुहृद् अ-सुहृद्, त्, m. not a friend, an
enemy.

अ-सूति, इस्, f. non-production; obstruction, removal;
barrenness.

1. आ-सुति, इस्, f. distilling; decoction; a draught so
prepared; distillation: (for 2. आ-सुति see next col.)
—आसुती-वल, अस्, m. a sacrificing priest; a sacrificer
at the full and change of the moon; one who pre-
pares or sells spirituous liquors, a distiller; one who
sells female slaves (?).
2. आ-सुति, इस्, f., Ved. exciting, enlivening.
अ-सूसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not bringing forth, barren.

असूक्ष्म अ-सूक्ष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, not fine, not
minute, large, thick, gross.

असूय असूय (fr. असु), nom. P. A. असूयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to murmur at, to detract from, depre-
ciate; to envy, scorn, be displeased or discontented
with, or grumble at (with dat. or acc.): Caus. असू-
ययति, -यितुम्, to cause to murmur or be displeased
or discontented.
2. आशुया, ind., Ved. quickly, rapidly.

असूयक, अस्, इका, अम्, detracting, envious, calum-
nious, discontented, displeased; (by some written
असूक ?).
असूयन, अम्, n. calumny, detraction.
असूययित्वा, ind. having scorned, having cursed.

असूयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, murmuring, detracting, dis-
pleased.

असूयु, उस्, उस्, उ, envious, displeased; (उस्), m.
calumny.

असूर्क्षण असूर्क्षण, अम्, n. disrespect.
See असूक्षण.

असूर्त अ-सूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not moving,
remote (?).

अ-सूर्यम्-पश्या, f. the wife of a king who being
shut up in the inner apartments never sees the sun,
a chaste and loyal wife.

आशुशुक्षणि आ-शुशुक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt.
शुच् with आ), Ved. shining forth; (Sāy.) ‘being
worshipped on account of shining very quickly’ or
‘causing sorrow (to one's enemies’); (इस्), m. fire,
wind; air.
आसुरायण, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.

आसुरि, इस्, m. (patron. fr. असुर), N. of a teacher.
—आसुरि-वासिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Prāśnīputra.

आसुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or coming from
Āsuri.

आसूत्रित आ-सूत्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, tied on or
round, forming or wearing a garland.
